{{Otheruses|Whale}}
The '''ruhau-whale''' was an animal found on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. The bones of the creature were used in the [[Ossic architecture/Legends|Ossic]] architecture of the natives. The landing platform structures in [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] were known to have been constructed from ruhau-whale bones.
{{Creature-stub}}
